text_help_warrior:
"Warrior
----------------------------
Defeat the enemies to advance through the stages. Warrior stats can be increased by doing other jobs too.

Enemies may drop collectable cards.
Exceeding cards can be dismantled into Bits, or convert 6 of them into a random one."
text_help_miner:
Miner
----------------------------
Break rocks to collect ores and upgrade your weapon's level to increase the damage dealt to enemies.
Rocks have a chance to drop at most one rarity higher than theirs, and not all rocks will drop ores.
text_help_fisher:
Fisher
----------------------------
Catch all fishes of a group to unlock a bonus.
Extra fishes will be automatically converted into Bits.
Different fishes can be found at different times of the day, like morning, afternoon, and evening.
Changing job will interrupt the current fishing session and reset the timer of the hook.
text_help_blacksmith:
Blacksmith
----------------------------
Refine ores into metals to upgrade your equipment level. They will increase the Warrior stats.
If there is not enough amount of the selected ore to refine, the Blacksmith will idle.
text_help_farmer:
Farmer
----------------------------
Grow crops to attract wild creatures, and after they eat, there is a chance they become your companions.
A new seed will be unlocked every 5 level of the Agronomy stat.
Companions can be equipped to help the Warrior through the stages.

Extra befriended companions of the same species will be automatically converted into Bits.

Your companions may appear while farming and chill with you.
text_description_warrior: Description: Defeat the enemies to advance through the stages. Enemies may drop collectable cards
text_description_miner: Description: Collect ores to upgrade your weapon level. It will increase the damage dealt to enemies
text_description_blacksmith: Description: Refine ores into metals to upgrade your equipment level. They will increase the Warrior stats
text_description_fisher: Description: Fish into the lake and catch all fishes of a group to unlock a bonus
text_description_farmer_crops: Description: Select crops to grow. Wild creatures will be attracted by them, after they eat, there is a chance they become your companions
text_description_farmer_companions: Companions will help you defeating monsters, equip up to 3 companions at the same time
text_help_mage:
Mage
----------------------------
The Mage learns spells to autocast them when advancing through the stages.

Spells can be equipped through slots.
Spell can be ranked up to increase their effectivness.
Every 5 levels of Scholar ability a new spell is unlocked, and every 5 levels of Proficiency ability a new slot to equip spells will be unlocked.
text_description_mage: Description: Learn spells to autocast while advancing through the stages
text_help_alchemist:
Alchemist
----------------------------
The Alchemist crafts powerful items following repices.

Every 5 levels of Research ability a new recipe will be unlocked, some can also be purchased from the Shop
You can find them in the Inventory once they're crafted.
text_description_alchemist:
Description:
Craft powerful items following the recipes
text_description_mage_slots: Spells can be equipped in empty slots. A new slot is unlocked every 5 levels of Proficiency ability
text_help_necromancer:
Necromancer
----------------------------
Max out your Necromancer abilities to unlock new permanent rituals.
The Necromancer trains by making is summons fight themselves, increasing the Aptitude ability will also increase the amount of summons that will fight.
All Necromancer abilities will increase the summon statistics, except for aptitude and luck, that will also increase the amount of experience gained by the Necromancer.
text_description_necromancer:
Description:
Max out your Necromancer abilities to unlock new permanent rituals
text_help_bard:
Bard
----------------------------
The songs played by the Bard have no direct impact on the gameplay, you can chose whether play in random order or looping a single song.
When switching job, some abilities will have a 10% boost for half of the time the Bard played.
text_description_bard:
Description:
Play songs to chill a bit. Get a 10% boost on some abilities for half the time of played songs
